name: dsh-market-dock
description: DeepSeek Harness 的行情面板：免登录查看 A股/港股/美股实时行情、K线、分时、热榜、搜索、7×24 快讯。嵌入式面板 + 可拖拽行情徽标 + 输入框上方指数条。内置本地持仓（股数以本地文件为主数据，当日盈亏/持仓盈亏/市值按行情现算；同花顺投资账本降级为一次性导入/校对）、价格提醒（宿主侧 watcher，隐身期间照常弹系统通知）与「行情隐身」一键开关（面板/徽章/指数条一起卸载、行情轮询全停，左下角恢复胶囊一按即回）。非雪球官方产品，数据来自雪球公开 Web 接口。

scripts.test: node test/pnl-session.mjs && node test/pnl-cookie.mjs && node test/pnl-positions.mjs && node test/smoke-host.mjs && node test/pnl-rpc.mjs && node test/smoke-client.mjs && node test/config.mjs && node test/alerts.mjs && node test/alerts-watcher.mjs
scripts.verify: node tools/verify-bundle.mjs && node tools/verify-wiring.mjs && node tools/verify-install.mjs
scripts.check: node tools/build.mjs --check && node --check src/index.js && node --check src/client/index.js && node -e "new Function(require('fs').readFileSync('dynamic/host.js','utf8'))" && node -e "new Function(require('fs').readFileSync('dynamic/client.js','utf8'))" && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8'))"
